title.zh: 高铁排排看：四条新线开通
title.en: Rank the rails: four new high-speed lines

title.zh: China Focus: China opens four high-speed rail lines, expanding national network
title.en: China Focus: China opens four high-speed rail lines, expanding national network

text.zh: 宜昌至兴山高铁全长 101 公里，设计时速 350 公里。
text.en: The Yichang–Xingshan line is 101 km long, with a design speed of 350 km/h.

facts.quote: The 101-kilometer Yichang-Xingshan high-speed railway officially entered service on Monday.

text.zh: 雄安至商丘段正线全长 552 公里，最快 2 小时 27 分钟可达。
text.en: The Xiong'an–Shangqiu main line is 552 km; the fastest trip takes 2 hours 27 minutes.

facts.quote: with the main line measuring 552 kilometers long ... the fastest journey from Xiong'an to Shangqiu will take just 2 hours and 27 minutes

text.zh: 西安至安康段全长 171 公里，穿越秦岭，两端之间最快 45 分钟。
text.en: The 171-km Xi'an–Ankang section crosses the Qinling Mountains; trains link its ends in 45 minutes.

facts.quote: the 171-km Xi'an-Ankang section crosses the Qinling Mountains ... the train can travel between its two terminal stations in just 45 minutes

text.zh: 哈尔滨至伊春段全长 318 公里，是我国最北的高铁，两地铁路旅行时间由约 7 小时缩短至约 2 小时。
text.en: The 318-km Harbin–Yichun section is China's northernmost high-speed railway; it cuts the trip from about seven hours to roughly two.

facts.quote: the 318-km Harbin-Yichun section is China's northernmost high-speed railway ever constructed ... from about seven hours to roughly two hours

text.zh: 截至 2025 年底，全国铁路营业里程达 16.5 万公里，其中高铁超过 5 万公里；预计到 2035 年高铁将达 7 万公里。
text.en: By the end of 2025 China had 165,000 km of railways, including more than 50,000 km of high-speed rail; it plans 70,000 km of high-speed rail by 2035.

facts.quote: By the end of 2025, the country's total operating railway mileage had reached 165,000 km, including more than 50,000 km of high-speed rail.

intro.zh: 9 月 28 日，四段高铁同日开通。按报道内容给它们排序：第一轮按线路长度，第二轮按最快旅行时间。用 ↑ ↓ 调整顺序。
intro.en: Four high-speed rail sections opened on 28 September. Put them in order using the story: first by length, then by fastest journey time. Use ↑ ↓ to move a line.
